name: Dai-Dan Co., Ltd.
summary: Dai-Dan Co., Ltd. engages in the design, supervision, and construction of electrical, air conditioning, water hygiene, and firefighting facilities works and machinery in Japan. The company offers Hot Cure, a hospital room for immunocompromised patients; All-in-one CP unit, a cell culture processing facility; air conditioning system for hybrid operating room; MonoBooker, a system which makes the location of temporary equipment visible; brightness design solutions; CV4D, a Construction Visualizer 4D for field survey support; artificial intelligence solutions; REMOVIS, a building monitoring and management solutions; ZEB, which reduces energy consumption in buildings; and Enefice Kyushu, Enefice…
